haiku:
Golden steam rises
Soft custard drips like amber
Taste of sunshine bright
Happy #NationalRicePuddingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Pages glow in dusk
Ink drips like amber rain, soft
Readers sigh with joy
Happy #BookLoversDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunlight on your face
Soft snowflakes dance in bright air
Joy echoes in heart
#HappyBirthdayWhitneyHouston from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden marshmallow,
Molten chocolate on graham—
Sweet smoke curls to sky.
Happy #NationalSMoresDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft sun drifts over
Lazy cushions sigh with ease
Dreams nap in warm light
Happy #NationalLazyDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunlight on bright strings
Echoes hum like summer drums
Joy ripples through chords
#HappyBirthdayLeoFender from @ClamBakeSanta

Cheese melts in pan soft
Crackling bread, aroma swirls
Warm bite, sunshine bite
Happy #NationalPaniniDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft waves kiss the shore
Children laugh, shells sparkle bright
Sand dunes rise like waves
Happy #PlayInTheSandDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft candle glow light
Crinkled paper wishes rise
Joyful laughter rings
#HappyBirthdayAlexHaley from @ClamBakeSanta
